# SkillGems

> Curated, link-verified directory of 42 AI agent skills (SKILL.md format): official releases from Anthropic, Microsoft, Cloudflare, Angular, LambdaTest plus the strongest community collections. Every link verified 2026-10-07. Agents: fetch https://skillgems.kuige.me/data/catalog.json for the full machine-readable catalog.

## Quick start for agents

1. Fetch https://skillgems.kuige.me/data/catalog.json (JSON: id, name, author, url, stars, category, bilingual descriptions, install hints).
2. Filter by `category` (official/collections/dev/writing/design/science/security/business/toolbox) or search `tags`.
3. Open the entry's GitHub `url` and follow its README for the exact install path (default: copy the skill folder to `~/.claude/skills/`).
4. Treat skills as code: review contents and license before installing.

## Official (6)

- [Anthropic Skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): The official Anthropic skills repo: document powerhouses (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf), skill-creator for authoring your own, mcp-builder, frontend-design, web-artifacts-builder, canvas-design and more — installable as a plugin marketplace. (★180k)
- [Cloudflare Security Audit](https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill): Cloudflare's official coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits, with independently verified, machine-readable findings. (★25.6k)
- [Microsoft Skills](https://github.com/microsoft/skills): Microsoft's official skills, MCP servers, custom agents and AGENTS.md templates for grounding coding agents across their SDKs and developer stack. (★3.1k)
- [Angular Skills](https://github.com/angular/skills): The Angular team's official agent skills — framework-accurate guidance for building and modernizing Angular apps with coding agents. (★670)
- [LambdaTest Agent Skills](https://github.com/LambdaTest/agent-skills): LambdaTest's official collection of 50+ testing skills: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, pytest, Jest and more, wired to their cloud test platform. (★377)
- [Courier Notifications](https://github.com/trycourier/courier-skills): Courier's official skill for building production-ready notifications across email, SMS, push, in-app, Slack and Teams. (★14)

## Collections (5)

- [Awesome Claude Skills](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills): One of the largest curated lists of Claude skills, resources and tools — the fastest way to survey the whole ecosystem from one README. (★76.6k)
- [Claude Skills Mega-Pack](https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills): A mega-pack of 380 Claude Code skills plus 30+ agents and 70+ custom commands — breadth first, ideal for assembling your own toolkit. (★27.8k)
- [Khazix Skills](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/khazix-skills): Khazix's open-source AI skills collection: leader (goal definition), neat-freak, hv-analysis, khazix-writer and more — practical Chinese-community favorites. (★21.2k)
- [AI Guide · 程序员鱼皮](https://github.com/liyupi/ai-guide): Yupi's AI resource compendium plus zero-basics vibe coding tutorials: model playbooks, OpenClaw walkthroughs and skills guidance for Chinese developers. (★20.8k)
- [Awesome Claude Skills · travisvn](https://github.com/travisvn/awesome-claude-skills): A well-maintained curated list of awesome Claude skills, resources and tools with clear category navigation. (★15.3k)

## Dev (10)

- [Superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers): Jesse Vincent's agentic skills framework and software development methodology: TDD, debugging, planning and collaboration skills that turn Claude Code into a disciplined engineer. The project that kicked off the skills boom. (★296.2k)
- [Graphify](https://github.com/Graphify-Labs/graphify): Turn any codebase — docs, SQL schemas, configs, PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph via a /graphify skill, so agents can navigate large systems instead of guessing. (★124.5k)
- [Agent-Reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach): Give your agent eyes on the whole internet: read and search Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and more from one skill, with content delivered in a form agents can reason over. (★92.9k)
- [Archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify): Turn any idea, plan or codebase into beautiful interactive diagrams. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and beyond — great for architecture docs and READMEs. (★79k)
- [Planning with Files](https://github.com/OthmanAdi/planning-with-files): Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: crash-proof markdown plans, session memory and long-running task state that survives restarts. (★27.3k)
- [Claude Code Game Studios](https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios): Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio: 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills and a complete coordination system for shipping games. (★25.8k)
- [SwiftUI Expert Skill](https://github.com/AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill): Expert SwiftUI best-practices guidance in the open Agent Skills format — keeping generated Swift code production-grade. (★3.7k)
- [Gamedev Agent Skills](https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills): 74 game-dev skills for AI coding agents: Godot, Unity, Unreal, Phaser, PixiJS, three.js, Bevy, pygame, LÖVE and more. (★1.3k)
- [Video Spec Builder](https://github.com/feicaiclub/video-spec-builder): Turns 'I want a video' into a second-precise storyboard spec (video-spec.md) for HyperFrames to render — one command installs it into Claude Code / Cursor / Codex. (★1k)
- [Self-Learning Skills](https://github.com/Kulaxyz/self-learning-skills): A self-improving skill: recognize hard-won golden paths while coding and persist them as reusable skills for the next run. (★960)

## Writing (4)

- [Prompt Master](https://github.com/nidhinjs/prompt-master): A skill that writes accurate prompts for any AI tool — full context assembly with zero tokens wasted on guesswork. (★14.1k)
- [Sepia](https://github.com/Nanako0129/sepia): De-AI writing skill compatible with 77+ Agent Skills agents (native plugins for Claude and more): repairs narrative structure and humanizes prose. (★3k)
- [Huashu md↔html](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-md-html): Huashu's bidirectional md/html pipeline: anything → markdown, markdown → beautiful HTML, HTML → markdown — wrapping markitdown, Pandoc and html-to-markdown. (★908)

## Toolbox (4)

- [Book to Skill](https://github.com/virgiliojr94/book-to-skill): Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference and use while you work. Books stop gathering dust. (★34k)
- [NotebookLM Py](https://github.com/teng-lin/notebooklm-py): Unofficial Python API and agentic skill for Google NotebookLM: full programmatic access to notebooks, sources and generated content. (★19.6k)
- [SkillOpt](https://github.com/microsoft/SkillOpt): Microsoft Research's text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents — the science of making skills better. (★18.1k)
- [Skill Seekers](https://github.com/yusufkaraaslan/Skill_Seekers): Convert documentation sites, GitHub repos and PDFs into Claude-ready skills automatically, with conflict detection when merging sources. (★15.1k)
